description: Depth-2 numerical witness for conj:bring-figure-eight-depth-2-witness — the depth-2 instance of the keystone conjecture conj:gb-depth-period-correspondence.  The figure-8 knot 4_1 embeds in Bring's genus-4 surface via the 4-strand braid word sigma_1 sigma_2^{-1} sigma_1 sigma_2^{-1}.  The depth-2 grouplike Li_2^q at the regular-ideal-tetrahedron shape z = e^(i pi/3) has std-part 2 Cl_2(pi/3) = Vol(S^3 \ 4_1) by Lobachevsky-Thurston. Computed at 50 decimal digits via mpmath.polylog. The Clausen-series 2M-term partial sum is a low-precision sanity check (~13-digit / SnapPy-range agreement), NOT a 50-digit independent cross-validation. Per Copilot PR #634 review.

algebraic_side_clausen.purpose: sanity check at SnapPy precision range only

fifty_digit_value_authority: mpmath.polylog at mp.dps=50 is the canonical computation; cross-validation to 50 digits would require an independent high-precision routine (e.g. Lobachevsky integral via mpmath.quad or BBP-style formula) — deferred

geometric_identification.justification: figure-8 complement = 2 regular ideal tetrahedra (Thurston 1978); regular-tet volume = D(e^(i pi/3)).
geometric_identification.snappy_consistency_low_precision: matches SnapPy 3.3.2 verified hyperbolic structure to its ~15-digit working precision; full 50-digit value is the canonical algebraic computation

interpretation: Single Li_2 ⇒ iterated-integral depth 2 ⇒ Goncharov period-class P_2/P_1 (Bloch regulator).  Predicted by conj:gb-depth-period-correspondence.
open_question_partition_filtration: The cellular GB-depth on Z(H_n(q)) (max-hook of partition, per prop:curvature-rank-gb-stratification) is a SEPARATE filtration from the iterated-integral depth on G(H_q).  Their relationship is open: the (2,2) self-conjugate cell of H_4(q) — where the amphichiral 4_1 lives — has max-hook = 3, NOT 2.  The depth match here is iterated-integral vs Goncharov, not partition-cellular vs Goncharov.  Pinning the precise relationship between the two filtrations is a follow-up open question.
